prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s

- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [sign_in, reorder] Defer Sign-In After Pet Creation: Move sign-in after pet selection and photo upload so users create their companion before committing to an account. (why: Sign-in currently has early dropoff (72.9% conversion); building emotional connection with the pet first boosts sign-in motivation.)
1: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Pet Controls Guide Screen: Insert a dedicated controls guide screen before completion explaining how to summon, move, and hide the desktop pet. (why: Multiple support tickets report post-onboarding confusion regarding how to control, talk to, or hide the pet.)
2: [adoption, new_flow] Custom Pet Generation Preset Fallback: Introduce visual preset selection cards on the photo upload screen as a reliable fallback if custom photo processing fails. (why: Support tickets highlighted custom pet creation failures and rendering issues during adoption.)
3: [home, wait_info] Desktop Pet Spawn Progress & Tips: Add an explicit progress bar, estimated time remaining, and tip carousel to the waiting screen while desktop pet assets render. (why: The waiting home step has a high median duration of 201s (mean 2336s) and complaints about the pet not displaying.)
4: [sign_in, incentive] Cloud Save Protected Sign-In Callout: Display explicit cloud backup trust badges on the sign-in screen highlighting protection against pet progress loss. (why: 8 support emails complained about pets missing or resetting after signing back in.)
5: [choose_path, copy] Streamlined Value Proposition Story Copy: Update initial story headline and body text to immediately explain what a desktop pet companion does. (why: The choose_path step takes a long mean time (514s), indicating user hesitation at the very start of onboarding.)
6: [home, notification] Desktop Ready System Notification: Enable desktop system notifications and explicit status text so users know when their pet has loaded on the screen. (why: Mean wait time of 2336s indicates users switch away while waiting and lose track of app launch.)
7: [finish, hint] Desktop Pet Shortcut Visual Hint: Add a visual hotkey badge and interactive hint on the home intro screen showing how to summon the pet. (why: Support emails show confusion about pet visibility on desktop and lost control post-onboarding.)
